Regions¶

Region interchange with CASA CRTF and DS9 region files, and statistics inside a region (backend/app/routers/regions.py, parsing in backend/app/regions.py). Regions drawn in CARTA, CASA or ds9 can be loaded into the client and the client’s regions written back out.

Canonical region¶

Every route speaks the same JSON region model:

{ "shape": "circle", "frame": "icrs", "center": [83.822, -5.391],
  "radius": 30.0, "unit": "arcsec", "props": { "color": "green", "text": "" } }

Field

Meaning

shape

circle, ellipse, box, polygon, point or annulus

frame

image or a world frame: icrs, fk5, galactic

center

Pixels when frame is image, otherwise decimal degrees

radius

Circle

radii

Annulus, [inner, outer]

semi_axes

Ellipse, [major, minor]

size

Box, [width, height]

angle_deg

Ellipse and box position angle

points

Polygon vertices, pixels or degrees according to frame

unit

Unit of the sizes and radii: pix, deg, arcsec or arcmin (always pix in the image frame)

props

Optional cosmetics such as color and text

Frame conversion¶

parse and export take an optional to_frame: empty keeps each region in its own frame, image converts to pixels, and a world frame converts to that frame (any other value means the dataset’s own world frame). A conversion needs dataset_id, whose celestial WCS is used (422 without dataset_id, or when the dataset has no celestial WCS). These two routes use the 1-based pixel convention of FITS and of the region files.

Routes¶

POST /v1/regions/parse¶

Parse CRTF or DS9 text into canonical regions.

{ "text": "# Region file format: DS9 version 4.1\nfk5\ncircle(83.822,-5.391,30\")",
  "format": "auto", "dataset_id": "", "to_frame": "" }

format is auto (detected from the text), crtf or ds9. Response: {valid, error, format, n_regions, regions}. Text that cannot be parsed is 422.

POST /v1/regions/export¶

Serialise canonical regions to CRTF or DS9 text.

{ "regions": [{ "shape": "box", "frame": "image", "center": [100, 120],
                "size": [40, 20], "angle_deg": 0, "unit": "pix" }],
  "format": "crtf", "dataset_id": "", "to_frame": "" }

format (crtf or ds9) is required. Response: {valid, error, format, text}. A region that cannot be written is 422.

POST /v1/regions/stats/{dataset_id}¶

Pixel statistics inside one region.

{ "region": { "shape": "circle", "frame": "image", "center": [120, 88],
              "radius": 6, "unit": "pix" },
  "channel": null }

An image region is in 0-based pixels; a world-frame region is converted to pixels through the dataset’s WCS first. channel selects the plane of a cube (default 0). Response: valid, error, shape, total_count, valid_count, blanked_count, min, max, mean, rms (standard deviation), sum, median, mad_sigma (1.4826 × MAD), bunit, channel, flux_jy, and beam_area_pix when a flux was computed. flux_jy is the sum divided by the beam area in pixels, set only for per-beam data with a known beam (otherwise null). A region with no finite pixel is 422.
